title: Toric geometry of Schouten squares on rotational double extensions
summary: Let $\g=\fb\oplus V\oplus\fb^{*}$ be a Medina-Revoy rotational double extension in which an abelian Lie algebra $\fb$ acts by scalar rotations on an orthogonal sum of oriented Euclidean two-planes. We analyse the restriction of the Schouten square $r\mapsto[r,r]$ to the block-rank-one locus $\Rone\subset\fb\wedge V$ and to its nondegenerate open part $\Rplus$. On every marked slice $S_{H}\subset\Rplus$ the Schouten square splits orthogonally into a radial and an angular component.
